== Biography ==
'''Isabel Glasgow''' was born on 23 Apr 1741 and baptized at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 26 Apr 1741. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-4165|George Glasgow]].<ref name="FMP1" /> The register records both dates; Irvine is inferred from the baptism and is not independently recorded.

Isabel Glasgow was one of the children recorded to George Glasgow in the Irvine register, alongside [[Glasgow-4103|Magdalen]] (1743), [[Glasgow-4126|Mary]] (1745).
